# Order Fill

> Order Fill fills supplier Excel order forms from 1C exports, lets users review
> matching decisions, and produces final workbooks. It also supports a North
> workflow for consolidating city demand, transfers, and supplier orders.

## Current runtime

- Frontend: React 19 + Vite 7, served by nginx in Docker.
- Public backend: `backend/services/gateway-service` over HTTP.
- Internal backend: independent Go 1.26.7 modules communicating over gRPC.
- Async work: Redis Stream `order-fill:jobs`, consumed by `document-worker`.
- Durable state: PostgreSQL and S3-compatible object storage.
- Local infrastructure: PostgreSQL 18, Redis 8, and MinIO through Docker Compose.

The active backend is under `backend/`. Historical design documents may mention
retired root-level services; do not treat those paths as current runtime code.

## Sources of truth

- `README.md`: project overview, setup, configuration, and deployment.
- `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`: current system architecture and workflows.
- `docs/service-boundaries.md`: ownership and forbidden dependencies.
- `backend/deploy/docker-compose.yml`: local runtime topology and wiring.
- `backend/services/gateway-service/api/openapi.yaml`: canonical public HTTP API.
- `backend/proto/orderfill/**/*.proto`: canonical internal gRPC contracts.
- `backend/services/*/README.md`: service-specific operation and configuration.
- `CONTRIBUTING.md`: development workflow and verification rules.

Files under `docs/plans/` are design and implementation history. When a plan
disagrees with code, Compose, OpenAPI, protobuf, or an active service README,
prefer the latter sources.

## Components

- `gateway-service`: browser-facing HTTP API and gRPC orchestration.
- `identity-service`: users, companies, roles, invites, and sessions.
- `twofa-service`: TOTP enrollment, verification, backup codes, and rate state.
- `passkey-service`: WebAuthn credentials and ceremony state.
- `job-service`: jobs, status, reports, output metadata, and Redis publishing.
- `file-service`: file metadata and S3-compatible object operations.
- `document-service`: `document-api` plus the Excel-processing `document-worker`.
- `matching-service`: item normalization and matching decisions.
- `brand-service`: brand catalog, detection, and brand policies.
- `calculation-service`: order quantities, edit validation, and North planning.
- `audit-service`: append/list audit events.

## Common commands

```bash
cp .env.example .env
make up
make logs
make down
make test
make lint
make verify
make security
make -C backend proto-gen
```

`make verify` is the deterministic local pre-commit gate. It checks pinned
toolchains, documentation links, HTTP/OpenAPI drift, protobuf lint, frontend,
every Go module, security linting, module tidiness, and Docker Compose. CI runs
the same layers in parallel and adds race/shuffled tests, govulncheck, and
protobuf breaking-change detection.

## Security and data handling

- Never commit `.env`, credentials, TLS private keys, or files under
  `testdata/private/`.
- Production uses fail-fast config validation for stateful services.
- Production browser origins must be explicit HTTPS origins.
- Production session cookies must be secure.
- Production passkeys require a matching `WEBAUTHN_RP_ID` and HTTPS origin.
- Production 2FA requires a non-default `TWOFA_MASTER_KEY` of at least 32 bytes.
- Internal gRPC supports `insecure`, `tls`, and `mtls`; local Compose defaults to
  `insecure`, while the documented production baseline uses `mtls`.
